title: README says port 5000 but app runs on 5001
evidence: README.md:35 states http://localhost:5000; app.py:173 uses port=5001
suggestion: Align README to port 5001 (or make the port configurable)

title: ?author= filter uses LIKE '%..%' substring match, not exact
evidence: app.py:81 'SELECT * FROM books WHERE author LIKE ?' with f'%{author}%'
suggestion: Acceptable; note that partial matches (e.g. 'Author' matches both 'Author A' and 'Author B') differ from exact filtering — tests pass because names are distinct
